crossRefs.note: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,

parallels.note: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.

people.name: Holy_Place
people.line: The inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple

translations.web: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,
translations.bsb: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Jehovah,
